meta.title: HSK 1 — Mandarin Chinese
meta.subtitle: 150 words · both directions, as two subdecks
meta.desc: Both study directions in one deck, as subdecks you can add and study separately: Chinese → English (see the characters, recall the meanings and the pinyin) and English → Chinese (see an English meaning, recall the characters and the pinyin). All 150 words of the official HSK 1 vocabulary list (HSK 2.0, the 2012 syllabus). Every card carries the simplified form, the traditional form, pinyin, bopomofo, the measure word where the word takes one, and the full range of English translations rather than a single gloss. Traditional characters are shown at half strength, and are omitted entirely where they are identical to the simplified — 82 of the 150 words. Word list: the official HSK 2012 Level 1 syllabus. Definitions: CC-CEDICT (CC BY-SA 4.0).
